hydro_auto_replant.name: hydro_auto_replant.summary
Hydroponic Auto Replant: Adds a per-machine auto replant toggle. When a ready machine with an empty seed slot finishes a cycle it takes one seed from its output tray.

hydro_auto_replant.name: hydro_auto_replant.toggle_hint
Hydroponic Auto Replant: When enabled; a ready machine with an empty seed slot takes one seed from its output tray after a cycle or when you enable the toggle. Works with the window closed.
